nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The study annex: leather, ledgers, a desk drawer that pretends to be locked. Taly Renn is already here, reading you faster than the books.

choices.text: Search the desk while looking scholarly.
Acknowledge Taly before she acknowledges you harder.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Between tariff tables: a shipping schedule with a date that doesn't match the public guest cipher. Fragment acquired — if you can walk out looking bored.

effects.summary: Found shipping discrepancy in study annex.

faculty_interjections.text: Pocket it. Face neutral. Exit with purpose.

choices.text: Nod at a bookshelf and leave.

nodes.speaker: taly_renn
nodes.text: Orth. You look like a man arguing with a desk. Maris said you might. She also said you're almost harmless — which is the dangerous kind.

faculty_interjections.text: She's protective of Maris. Earn that or don't poke it.

choices.text: I'm trying not to make her evening worse.

nodes.speaker: taly_renn
nodes.text: Fine. Don't steal anything that screams. Maris hates screaming furniture.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You return to the salon with empty hands and a full pulse.
